name: motion-fx-lab
description: Motion graphics as web pages, rendered frame-exact to MP4: social clips, product demos, infographics and B-roll.

scripts.build:showcase: npm run render:fluid-films && npm run build:materials && npm run build:studio && npm run render:design-films && npm run render:stacks && bash video/build.sh examples/optical.html && bash video/build.sh video/intro.html
scripts.build:studio: npm run render:style-journey && npm run render:dot-battle && npm run render:fight-effects
scripts.build:all: npm run build:showcase && bash video/build.sh examples/reel.html && bash video/build.sh examples/product.html && bash video/build.sh examples/infographic.html && bash video/build.sh examples/broll.html
scripts.build:materials: bash video/build.sh examples/water-forms.html && bash video/build.sh examples/word-forms.html && bash video/build.sh examples/scene-eras.html
scripts.render:fluid-films: bash video/build.sh examples/fluid-overflow.html && bash video/build.sh examples/fluid-viscous.html && bash video/build.sh examples/fluid-smoke.html
scripts.render:design-films: bash video/build.sh examples/dot-story.html && bash video/build.sh examples/ink-city.html && bash video/build.sh examples/shadow-lab.html
